scope: Tiny deterministic local contracts; runtime qualification is separate.

cases.title: Parse a strict optional amount
cases.input_contract: Accept trimmed ASCII digits representing 0 through 1000000 cents. Return None for absent, blank, signed, decimal, overflowing or supplied-null tokens. Do not convert invalid input to zero or call unchecked Option.get.
cases.expected: Some("0") gives Some(0L), Some(" 25 ") gives Some(25L), None and Some("bad") give None. Some(null), Some("-1"), Some("1.0") and values above the bound are rejected.
cases.verification: Assert accepted zero and 25 independently, then test each invalid token and absence without an exception.

cases.title: Separate absence from invalid supplied content
cases.input_contract: Return observed for a valid supplied amount, missing for None, and rejected for any invalid Some token including Some(null). Keep the original input state available when classifying.
cases.expected: Some("0"), Some("25"), None, Some("bad"), Some(null) map to observed, observed, missing, rejected, rejected.
cases.verification: Assert the five classifications in order and show that parseAmount alone returns None for both missing and rejected cases.

cases.title: Collect only observed numerical values
cases.input_contract: Return valid parsed amounts in original order using flatMap. Preserve zero and duplicate amounts; do not substitute defaults for missing or rejected tokens.
cases.expected: The five-token fixture yields Seq(0L,25L). Adding another Some("25") yields two 25-cent occurrences.
cases.verification: Assert exact observed sequences and an all-missing/rejected fixture returning empty.

cases.title: Reconcile all input states
cases.input_contract: Return counts for all three keys observed, missing, rejected, including zero counts. Classify every original token and require the counts to sum to input size.
cases.expected: The five-token fixture yields observed 2, missing 1, rejected 2. Empty input retains all three keys with count 0.
cases.verification: Assert the full map, its summed count, and the explicit empty-ledger keys.

cases.title: Keep presentation distinct from measurement
cases.input_contract: Return a valid amount as decimal text, or the literal missing/rejected classification for unavailable values. Do not display every unavailable value as 0.
cases.expected: Some("0") displays"0", None displays"missing", and Some("bad") displays"rejected". Whitespace around a valid 25 is normalized to"25".
cases.verification: Assert all four display strings and verify that missing is not numerically indistinguishable from observed zero.

cases.title: Compose a downstream calculation without losing absence
cases.input_contract: Return the five-percent integer-cent fee for a valid parsed amount and None otherwise. Compose the calculation through Option rather than using getOrElse(0L) before the fee calculation.
cases.expected: Some("100") gives Some(5L), Some("0") gives Some(0L), and None or Some("bad") remain None.
cases.verification: Assert presence and exact fee for valid zero and 100, then absence for both invalid and missing inputs.
